## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The diff stays inside the proposal's scope
- [ ] Every new or changed criterion has a test named after it, seen red then green
- [ ] No assertion weakened, no test skipped, no criterion edited to make a test pass
- [ ] Hard rules (AGENTS.md) and pack dependencies (package.yml) unchanged (or changed by an approved change)
- [ ] No new dependency unless the proposal asked for it
- [ ] `bin/ci` green
- [ ] `docs/specs/` and `docs/requirements.yml` match the proposal's delta
